_comment: v3: film time -> scene time for Mixkit #190 (120 BPM). Pairs are [sceneTime, filmTime]. Musical anchors on the 120-BPM grid: scene 3.75 = film 6.0 (cut to the stat, start of the quiet break), scene 7.5 = film 12.0 (drop on the red check), scene 13.59 = film 22.0 (click, on the beat). Long film spans over short scene spans are reading holds. Used by film.html, render.py and audio.py.
